title: Return an error status
summary: Django: Return an error status. Inspect the 404 status too.
introduction: The response status describes the result. Open GET /missing/ to see a 404 reply.
learningObjectives: Return an error status with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Return an error status

blocks.text: The status keyword sets 404 while the dictionary supplies the error body.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Returning error text with status 200 can mislead clients.

seo.title: Django: Return an error status
seo.description: Django: Return an error status. Inspect the 404 status too. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
